Under strict forensic auditor mandate ('If ANY check fails, your verdict is INTEGRITY VIOLATION'), the verdict must be INTEGRITY VIOLATION.

3_execution_safety_check.details: Full AST inspection of all 15 Python files in tests/adversarial/ confirmed 100% read-only operations. Zero network libraries imported (requests, urllib, socket, etc.), zero download calls, zero file write/mutation calls (open in write mode, unlink, remove, rmtree all absent).

4_codebase_immutability_check.details: git diff src/ returned 48,944 characters of diff (expected 0 bytes changed). Unstaged modifications detected in src/chakra_transformer/transformer_segmenter.py (+200, -21) and src/models/chakranet_segmenter.py (+281, -62), plus staged modifications in src/conformal/conformal_calibration.py (+483, -403). Root cause: Concurrent cross-generational execution by worker_m1_g13 (Gen 13) injecting inline tensor comments into model source files, violating the codebase immutability invariant required for Milestone 2.
